dialogue.french: Bonjour Jeanne, comment allez-vous ?
dialogue.english: Hello Jeanne, how are you (how go you)?
dialogue.pronunciation: boh-zhoor zhahn, koh-mah-tah-lay voo

dialogue.french: Bien, et vous ?
dialogue.english: Well, and you?
dialogue.pronunciation: byah ay voo

dialogue.french: Ça va très bien, merci.
dialogue.english: (It goes) Very well, thanks.
dialogue.pronunciation: sah-vah tray byah, mair-see

dialogue.french: Je vous présente ma fille, Chloé.
dialogue.english: Let me introduce (I present you) my daughter, Chloe.
dialogue.pronunciation: zhuh voo pray-zah-tuh ma fee, klo-ay

dialogue.french: Bonjour, Chloé. Comment ça va ?
dialogue.english: Hello, Chloe. How are you (it goes)?
dialogue.pronunciation: boh-zhoor klo-ay, koh-mah sah vah

dialogue.french: Monsieur, madame, vous désirez ?
dialogue.english: Sir, Madam, [what] would you like (you desire)?
dialogue.pronunciation: muh-syuh, mah-dahm, voo day-zee-ray

dialogue.french: Deux cafés et deux croissants, s'il vous plaît.
dialogue.english: Two coffees and two croissants, please (if it pleases you).
dialogue.pronunciation: duh kah-fay ay duh krwah-sah, seel voo play

dialogue.french: Non, je préfère une tartine beurrée pour le petit-déjeuner.
dialogue.english: No, I prefer a slice of buttered bread for (the) breakfast.
dialogue.pronunciation: noh, zhuh pray-fair ewn tar-teen buh-ray poor luh puh-tee day-zhuh-nay

dialogue.french: Donc, deux_expressos, un croissant et une tartine ?
dialogue.english: So, two espressos, one croissant and one slice of buttered bread?
dialogue.pronunciation: dohk, duhz-ex-pray-so, uh krwah-sah ay ewn tar-teen

dialogue.french: Oui, c'est ça. Le croissant est pour moi et la tartine pour elle.
dialogue.english: Yes, that's right (this is it). The croissant is for me and the bread for her.
dialogue.pronunciation: wee, say sah. Luh krwah-sah ay poor mwah ay la tar-teen poor el

dialogue.french: Je me présente : je m'appelle Sophie Mercier.
dialogue.english: [Let me] introduce myself (I introduce me): I am (I call myself) Sophie Mercier.
dialogue.pronunciation: zhuh muh pray-zah-tuh : zhuh mah-pel soh-fee mair-syay

dialogue.french: Et voici mon ami Loïc Le Gall. Il est breton.
dialogue.english: And here is my friend Loic Le Gall. He is Breton.
dialogue.pronunciation: ay vwah-see moh-nah-mee lo-eek luh gal. Eel ay bruh-toh

dialogue.french: Et vous, êtes-vous bretonne aussi ?
dialogue.english: And you, are you Breton, too?
dialogue.pronunciation: ay voo, et-voo bruh-ton oh-see

dialogue.french: Pas du tout, je suis de Nîmes, dans le Midi de la France.
dialogue.english: Not at all, I am from Nîmes, in the south of France.
dialogue.pronunciation: pah dew too, zhuh swee duh neem, dah luh mee-dee duh la frah-suh

dialogue.french: Mais maintenant nous sommes parisiens.
dialogue.english: But now we are Parisians.
dialogue.pronunciation: may mah-tuh-nah noo som pah-ree-zyah

dialogue.french: Pardon, est-ce que vous avez l'heure ?
dialogue.english: Excuse me (pardon), do you have the time (hour)?
dialogue.pronunciation: par-doh, es-kuh voo-zah-vay luhr

dialogue.french: Je n'ai pas de montre mais je pense qu'il est midi dix.
dialogue.english: I don't have a watch, but I think (that) it is ten past noon (noon ten).
dialogue.pronunciation: zhuh nay pah duh moh-truh may zhuh pah-suh keel ay mee-dee dees

dialogue.french: Mais comment le savez-vous ?
dialogue.english: But how do you know that (how it you know)?
dialogue.pronunciation: may koh-mah luh sah-vay voo

dialogue.french: Parce que j'ai rendez-vous avec ma femme à midi...
dialogue.english: Because I'm meeting (I have an appointment with) my wife at noon...
dialogue.pronunciation: pars-kuh zhay roh-day-voo ah-vek ma fam ah mee-dee

dialogue.french: ... et elle a toujours dix minutes de retard !
dialogue.english: ... and she is (has) always ten minutes (of) late!
dialogue.pronunciation: ay el ah too-zhoor dees mee-newt duh ruh-tar

dialogue.french: Excusez-moi, je cherche le métro Saint-Michel.
dialogue.english: Excuse me, I [am] look[ing] for the Saint-Michel metro [station].
dialogue.pronunciation: ex-kew-zay mwah, zhuh shersh luh may-troh sah-mee-shel

dialogue.french: Désolée, madame, je ne suis pas d'ici.
dialogue.english: Sorry, madam, I'm not from here.
dialogue.pronunciation: day-zoh-lay, mah-dahm, zhuh nuh swee pah dee-see

dialogue.french: Mais attendez une minute, j'ai un plan de la ville.
dialogue.english: But wait a minute, I have a map of the city.
dialogue.pronunciation: may ah-tah-day ewn mee-newt, zhay uh plah duh la veel

dialogue.french: Voilà : traversez le boulevard et tournez à gauche à la fontaine.
dialogue.english: Here [we are]: cross the boulevard and turn (to) left at the fountain.
dialogue.pronunciation: vwah-lah : trah-ver-say luh bool-uh-var ay toor-nay ah gohsh ah la foh-tayn

dialogue.french: Merci beaucoup pour votre aide !
dialogue.english: Thanks very much (a lot) for your help!
dialogue.pronunciation: mair-see boh-koo poor votr ed

dialogue.french: Bonsoir monsieur, bonsoir madame. Bienvenue à l'Hôtel Molière.
dialogue.english: Good evening, sir; good evening, madam. Welcome to the Molière Hotel.
dialogue.pronunciation: boh-swahr muh-syuh, boh-swahr mah-dahm. Byah-vuh-new ah lo-tel moh-lyair

dialogue.french: Bonsoir, nous avons une chambre réservée pour deux nuits.
dialogue.english: Good evening, we have a room reserved for two nights.
dialogue.pronunciation: boh-swahr, noo-zah-voh ewn shah-bruh ray-zervay poor duh nwee

dialogue.french: Quel est votre nom, s'il vous plaît ?
dialogue.english: What is your name, please?
dialogue.pronunciation: kel ay votr noh, seel voo play

dialogue.french: Je m'appelle Bailly : B-A-I deux L-Y. Alain.
dialogue.english: My name is (I call myself) Bailly: B-A-I double-L-Y. Alain.
dialogue.pronunciation: zhuh mah-pel bah-ee : bay-ah-ee duh el-ee-grek ah-lah

dialogue.french: Absolument : une grande chambre avec un grand lit et une salle de bains.
dialogue.english: Absolutely: a large room with a double (big) bed and a bathroom (room of bath).
dialogue.pronunciation: ab-soh-lew-mah : ewn grah-d shah-bruh ah-vek uh grah lee ay ewn sal duh bah

dialogue.french: C'est au quatrième étage. Voici la clé.
dialogue.english: It's on (at) the fourth floor. Here's the key.
dialogue.pronunciation: say oh kah-tree-em ay-tazh. Vwah-see la klay

dialogue.french: Où sont vos bagages ?
dialogue.english: Where are your bags (your luggage)?
dialogue.pronunciation: oo soh voh bah-gazh

dialogue.french: Bonjour Chloé, comment allez-vous ?
dialogue.english: Hello Chloe, how are you?
dialogue.pronunciation: boh-zhoor klo-ay, koh-mah-tah-lay voo

dialogue.french: Ça va très bien merci.
dialogue.english: Very well, thanks.
dialogue.pronunciation: sah vah tray byah mair-see

dialogue.french: Et vous ?
dialogue.english: And you?
dialogue.pronunciation: ay voo

dialogue.french: Très bien. Est-ce que vous avez l'heure ?
dialogue.english: Very well. Do you have the time?
dialogue.pronunciation: tray byah. Es-kuh voo-zah-vay luhr

dialogue.french: Désolée, je n'ai pas de montre.
dialogue.english: Sorry, I don't have a watch.
dialogue.pronunciation: day-zoh-lay, zhuh nay pah duh moh-truh

dialogue.french: Mais je pense qu'il est midi.
dialogue.english: But I think it's noon.
dialogue.pronunciation: may zhuh pah-suh keel ay mee-dee

dialogue.french: Comment le savez-vous ?
dialogue.english: How do you know?
dialogue.pronunciation: koh-mah luh sah-vay voo

dialogue.french: Parce que j'ai rendez-vous avec ma fille
dialogue.english: Because I have a meeting with my daughter
dialogue.pronunciation: pars-kuh zhay roh-day-voo ah-vek ma fee

dialogue.french: et elle a toujours cinq minutes de retard.
dialogue.english: and she's always late.
dialogue.pronunciation: ay el ah too-zhoor sah mee-newt duh ruh-tar

dialogue.french: Merci beaucoup pour votre aide.
dialogue.english: Thanks very much for your help.
dialogue.pronunciation: mair-see boh-koo poor votr ed

dialogue.french: Bonjour mademoiselle, est-ce que votre père est à la maison ?
dialogue.english: Good morning (Good day), miss. Is your father at home (Is it that your father is at the house)?
dialogue.pronunciation: boh-zhoor mad-mwah-zel, es-kuh votr pair ay ah la may-zoh

dialogue.french: Non, monsieur ; il est au bureau aujourd'hui.
dialogue.english: No, sir; he is at the office today.
dialogue.pronunciation: noh, muh-syuh ; eel ay oh bew-roh oh-zhoor-dwee

dialogue.french: À quelle heure est-ce qu'il rentre après le travail ?
dialogue.english: (At) what time (hour) [does] he come back after (the) work?
dialogue.pronunciation: ah kel uhr es-kuh eel rah-truh ah-pray luh trah-vye

dialogue.french: Oh, pas avant huit heures normalement.
dialogue.english: Oh, not before 8 o'clock (hours) normally.
dialogue.pronunciation: oh, pah zah-vah weet uhr nor-mal-mah

dialogue.french: Vous voulez l'adresse de son bureau ?
dialogue.english: [Do] you want the address of his office?
dialogue.pronunciation: voo voo-lay lah-dres duh soh bew-roh

dialogue.french: Oui, s'il vous plaît.
dialogue.english: Yes, (if you) please.
dialogue.pronunciation: wee, seel voo play

dialogue.french: Attendez un moment, je cherche mon carnet d'adresses.
dialogue.english: Wait a moment, I [am] looking for my address book.
dialogue.pronunciation: ah-tah-day uh moh-mah, zhuh shersh moh kar-nay dah-dres

dialogue.french: Voilà. Sept rue Marbeuf, dans le huitième.
dialogue.english: There [it is]. 7 rue (street) Marbeuf, in the 8th [district].
dialogue.pronunciation: vwah-lah. Set rew mar-buhf, dah luh wee-tyem

dialogue.french: Merci beaucoup, mademoiselle. Au revoir.
dialogue.english: Thank you very much, miss. Goodbye.
dialogue.pronunciation: mair-see boh-koo, mad-mwah-zel. Oh ruh-vwar

dialogue.french: De rien, monsieur. Au revoir.
dialogue.english: You're welcome (of nothing), sir. Goodbye.
dialogue.pronunciation: duh ryah, muh-syuh. Oh ruh-vwar

dialogue.french: Ce monsieur s'appelle Jérôme Laforge et cette dame est sa femme.
dialogue.english: This gentleman is called (calls himself) Jerome Laforge and this lady is his wife.
dialogue.pronunciation: suh muh-syuh sah-pel zhay-rohm lah-forzh ay set dam ay sa fam

dialogue.french: Ils sont à la mairie pour demander une nouvelle carte d'identité pour leur fils.
dialogue.english: They are at the town hall to (for) ask [for] a new identity card for their son.
dialogue.pronunciation: eel soh ah la may-ree poor duh-mah-day ewn noo-vel kart eed-tay-ee-tay poor luhr fees

dialogue.french: Quel âge a cet enfant ?
dialogue.english: How old is (what age has) this child?
dialogue.pronunciation: kel ahzh ah set ah-fah

dialogue.french: Il a huit ans, monsieur.
dialogue.english: He is (has) eight years [old], sir.
dialogue.pronunciation: eel ah weet ah, muh-syuh

dialogue.french: Et il s'appelle Laforge ? Est-ce que c'est votre enfant ?
dialogue.english: And he is called (calls himself) Laforge? Is it [he] your child?
dialogue.pronunciation: ay eel sah-pel lah-forzh ? Es-kuh say votr ah-fah

dialogue.french: Oui, monsieur.
dialogue.english: Yes, sir.
dialogue.pronunciation: wee, muh-syuh

dialogue.french: Bien. Et il habite chez vous ?
dialogue.english: Fine. And he lives with (at) you?
dialogue.pronunciation: byah. Ay eel ah-beet shay voo

dialogue.french: Mais évidemment, avec moi et sa mère !
dialogue.english: (But) obviously, with me and his mother.
dialogue.pronunciation: may ay-vee-dah-mah, ah-vek mwah ay sa mair

dialogue.french: D'accord. Je fais mon travail, c'est tout.
dialogue.english: OK. I'm doing my job, that's all.
dialogue.pronunciation: dah-kor. Zhuh fay moh trah-vye, say too

dialogue.french: Est-ce que vous avez le formulaire B-52 ?
dialogue.english: Do you have (the) form B-52?
dialogue.pronunciation: es-kuh voo-zah-vay luh for-mew-lair bay-sah-kah-do

dialogue.french: Oui monsieur, nous l'avons.
dialogue.english: Yes, sir, we have it (we it have).
dialogue.pronunciation: wee muh-syuh, noo lah-voh

dialogue.french: Et l'imprimé A-65 ?
dialogue.english: And the printed [form] A-65?
dialogue.pronunciation: ay lah-prah-may ah swah-sah-sah

dialogue.french: Ça aussi, nous l'avons.
dialogue.english: That also, we have it.
dialogue.pronunciation: sah oh-see, noo lah-voh

dialogue.french: Ah bon ? Mais est-ce que vous avez son passeport ?
dialogue.english: Oh really (good)? But do you have his passport?
dialogue.pronunciation: ah boh ? May es-kuh voo-zah-vay soh pas-por

dialogue.french: Bien sûr. Nous avons même sa photo.
dialogue.english: Of course. We have even his photo.
dialogue.pronunciation: byah sewr. Noo-zah-voh mem sa foh-toh

dialogue.french: Très bien. Alors je vous fais la carte. Voilà.
dialogue.english: Very well. So I'll do (am doing) you the card. Here it is.
dialogue.pronunciation: tray byah. Ah-lor zhuh voo fay la kart. Vwah-lah

dialogue.french: Réglez à la caisse, s'il vous plaît.
dialogue.english: Pay at the cash desk, please.
dialogue.pronunciation: ray-glay ah la kes, seel voo play

dialogue.french: Zut ! Je ne trouve pas mon portefeuille !
dialogue.english: Damn! I can't find (not find not) my wallet!
dialogue.pronunciation: zewt ! Zhuh nuh troov pah moh por-tuh-fuh
